title: Additional Parallax visual identity studies
scene: Shared bread shop encounter; generated illustration studies, no animation trials.

studies.name: Modernist cel animation
studies.style: Medium and drawing rules: mature modernist CEL ANIMATION DESIGN. A hand-inked frame on flat painted fields, boldly two dimensional. Thin irregular black-blue ink contours that sometimes stop short of color shapes, asymmetrical perspective, slightly angular shoulders but organic compact heads, tapered human limbs with believable joints. Expressive opposing poses: child leaning forward slightly, adult attentive with one elbow loosely bent. Clearly designed cuffs, apron tie, two careful finger shapes at the coin, a few bread slashes. Room reduced to three large architectural shapes; don't render every surface. A huge pale blue window and a skewed muted coral wall plane counterbalance a deep navy apron and counter. Palette: clean ivory, dark midnight blue, dusty cyan and restrained red-orange. Controlled flat fills, almost no shading, subtle hand-ink irregularity; no grain wash or vintage yellowing. Sparse lines and strongly designed poses convey observed human feeling. It should look like an ambitious theatrical animated film frame, never a retro mascot, stock cartoon, comic panel or vector infographic.
studies.prompt:
Create an original 16:9 still in a rigorously flat mid-century MODERNIST CEL ANIMATION design language, informed by UPA's bold abstraction. Adult philosophical film, visually witty and humane. The entire composition consists of flat opaque fields and a few lively irregular blue-black ink contours. Angular asymmetric rooms, compact oval heads with one hooked nose, simple hair silhouettes, narrow jointed limbs, broad triangular apron, specific small hands. Design every person from 6–10 large shapes with NO anatomical shading, skin rendering, beard strands or realistic fabric folds. Color planes occasionally sit slightly apart from the drawn contour. Pale ivory, dusty cyan, deep navy and one vivid coral wall. No texture filters.
Scene: a child on the LEFT holds one small coral coin toward an adult shopkeeper on the RIGHT behind a broad skewed counter. One flat oval loaf between them with three slashes, three jars drawn as spare loops behind the adult, large cyan window left. Keep silhouettes and hands distinct, posture expressive. Room mostly clean empty fields. Deliberately stylized geometry and graphic surprise, not anime, not realistic illustration, no text, no additional props.

studies.name: Conceptual line drawing
studies.style: Medium and drawing rules: conceptual PEN DRAWING as visual thought, elegant, cerebral and quietly witty. Clean warm-white paper occupies most of the frame. A single sinuous blue-black contour appears to travel from the window's boundary into the counter edge, then naturally becomes the adult's apron seam: an intelligible visual connection across spatial elements, still preserving readable people. Spare but specific irregular pen marks, light and heavy line decisions, beautiful open contours. Child and adult have distinct long nose/ear/jaw profiles, compact believable proportions and subtly observed stances, without eyes or mouth. Loaf drawn with only a few precise marks and three slashes. THREE jars as bare looping contours. Only two very small opaque vermilion fields: the coin and a small shape at window edge. Room largely unstated. No shading, hatching clouds, charcoal smudge, paper collage or photoreal volume. The main visual event is an inventive continuous line organizing the scene, not a generic whiteboard-explainer outline picture. Let its spatial double reading be legible and deliberate. Detail resides in the precision and personality of the marks.

studies.name: Architectural surrealism
studies.style: Medium and spatial rules: architectural SURREALISM painted in matte restrained opaque color. Use austere simplified contemporary architecture, long hard-edged shadows and an emotionally present tiny everyday encounter. The left half of the bread shop and the right half are each internally clear but meet at ONE deliberate spatial contradiction: the long counter changes its vanishing direction at the loaf, as if two legitimate viewpoints share one continuous surface. Keep counter usable and hands/body anatomy completely ordinary; the contradiction belongs to architecture. A tall window reveals a perfectly flat muted cyan rectangle. A doorway-like empty wall recess behind the adult has a vermilion interior plane, giving a memorable asymmetrical spatial anchor without additional objects. People occupy enough of frame to read posture and coin clearly, with sculptural simple painted profiles and economical clothing folds. Palette cool mineral blue, pale chalk, muted terra-cotta and near-black blue shadows; no nostalgic brown wash. Calm broad surfaces, slight dry painted edges and carefully chosen tonal planes. Enigmatic thoughtful atmosphere rather than horror, fantasy or dramatic digital concept art. No floating props, no extra loaves, no melting people. Spatial strangeness must feel intentional, composed and intellectually useful.
studies.prompt:
Create an original 16:9 METAPHYSICAL ARCHITECTURAL SURREALIST PAINTING for an adult philosophical film, informed by Giorgio de Chirico's simplified spaces and strange perspective. Clearly nonrealistic and visibly painted: large matte chalk-blue, ivory, burnt-vermilion and deep indigo planes, spare brush edges. No photographic rendering. TWO deliberately simplified human figures have smooth anonymous oval profile heads, noses defined only by silhouette, no eyes, no detailed hair or beard, no skin modeling. Clothes and limbs are sculpted from only two or three broad painted planes with coherent small hands.
A child stands LEFT holding one small coin toward a shopkeeper RIGHT behind a long counter. ONE loaf at center, three jars on one shelf behind the adult, large plain pale blue window left. A tall vermilion empty recess behind the adult anchors the room. ONE purposeful spatial contradiction: left and right halves of the counter have incompatible vanishing directions but join at the loaf as a continuous impossible surface. Long clean diagonal shadows. Humans remain prominent and tender through posture. Quiet cerebral tension, austere calm architecture, no extra objects, no text, no creepy faces, no floating bread, no realism, no 3D render.

studies.name: Ink wash with crisp figures
studies.style: Medium and drawing rules: contemporary INK WASH with crisp drawn HUMAN FIGURES. The background is organized by two broad translucent cool blue-gray brush washes, substantial untouched ivory paper and one restrained vermilion shape at the window. Visible diluted pigment pooling only at selected wash edges, expressive wet-to-dry transitions, no uniform grunge overlay. People have sharp blue-black economical ink contours and flat dark clothing shapes, more defined than the atmospheric room. Child's wrist, coat cuff and coin and adult's apron, hand and ear are drawn with a few carefully observed marks. Bread is a pale reserved-paper shape against a dark counter wash, with three assured brush slashes. THREE jars remain simple crisp outlines. Architecture can disappear into clean paper between strokes, but the people, coin and counter remain legible. Cool airy modernity, emotional restraint, brush specificity and spaciousness; no landscape foliage, no decorative blossoms, no antique scroll motifs, no cutesy watercolor or brown vintage illustration. The contrast between fluid atmosphere and sharply human contours is the identity.

studies.name: Drawn surreal collage
studies.style: Medium and construction rules: DRAWN SURREAL COLLAGE, a coherent printed assembly of deliberately cut and rearranged engraved illustrations. Preserve two anatomically ordinary contemporary people and the exact bread-shop objects, rendered with selective directional blue-black engraving. The counter is one clean cutout fragment; the window and its surrounding wall form a second rectangular fragment; the adult and shelf occupy a third. Their sharply cut boundaries and displaced architectural planes are visible: fragments of the same shop recomposed into an impossible yet readable shallow stage. One oversized clean vermilion interior wall plane crosses behind a smaller engraved wall fragment, creating a surprising difference of scale in architecture, not in anatomy. Fine engraved detail concentrated in hands, apron folds, loaf and a few selected shadow areas; large untouched ivory areas and broad solid navy planes balance it. No all-over dense Victorian filigree. Material feels printed from one unified ink source despite discontinuous perspective. No photographic scraps, magazine headlines, random eyes, extra people, gears, animals, labels, symbols or antique clothing. Mature surreal editorial storytelling with logical visual relationships and abrupt intentional edges.

studies.name: Rotoscope inspired editorial drawing
studies.style: Medium and drawing rules: an original ROTOSCOPE-INSPIRED EDITORIAL ANIMATION FRAME. Entire image is visibly drawn, with human weight and the specificity of an observed live performance translated into economical ink contours and 3 to 4 opaque painted planes per figure. Adult turns the upper body slightly toward the child, rests one separate open hand near but not on the loaf, other hand lower and distinct; child subtly shifts weight onto one foot while holding coin clearly. Adult face anonymous in side profile with specific ear, nose, jaw and cropped hair silhouette; child compact rounded profile with one small ear. Hands have coherent specific finger separations. Preserve restrained adult proportions rather than exaggerated vector limbs. Lines subtly wander in thickness and occasionally break, selected planes don't exactly meet the contour, yet anatomy stays very deliberate. Clothing: child muted cyan coat, adult pale shirt and midnight-blue apron, one vermilion accent at cuff. Background is flattened painted navy, chalk and cool blue architecture with only essential shelf/window edges. No photographic texture, gradients, lens blur, realistic skin modeling or filter-on-a-photo appearance. Feels like drawn observed life rather than digital traced clutter. This is a still visual study, not a claim that actual footage was traced.

studies.name: Pinscreen inspired tonal world
studies.style: Medium and light rules: PINSCREEN-INSPIRED MONOCHROME TONAL ANIMATION image, luminous sculptural shadows formed from countless tiny relief points yet visually resolved into broad velvety forms. Strict neutral black, silver gray and white; no sepia or color. The window is a clean luminous white rectangle cutting diagonally into a charcoal-dark room, defining the readable adult/child silhouettes and one pale loaf. Gently contoured heads, noses, ears, hands and fabric volume appear through brushed shadows, neither photoreal nor flat cartoon. Keep coin as one small pale disk separated from hand contour. Shelf and THREE jars subtle but readable. Soft gradations built from directional relief shading; choose a few smooth tonal masses with clear focal edges, no gritty noisy fog, no dot pattern pasted uniformly over scene. Counter is a broad dark relief plane with a single luminous top edge. Deep space with spare detail, contemplative unsettling beauty, quiet humanity. No film scratches, no lens effects, no charcoal line sketching or generic digital airbrush. Distinctive material shadow logic, like a handmade experimental animated film frame.

Strongly simplify the TWO human figures into smooth elongated sculptural profiles, nose only, blank faces, no visible hair strands, wrinkles or realistic skin. Their clothing forms only two or three gentle shadow masses. Tiny hands remain coherent in silhouette. Soft directional stipple belongs to relief shadows only, no pasted film grain.
A small child on the LEFT holds one tiny bright coin toward a tall attentive adult shopkeeper on the RIGHT behind a dark counter. One pale simple loaf between them, three rounded jars on a barely indicated shelf, one luminous rectangular window left. Counter edge is one thin glowing line. Most surroundings dissolve into dark gray negative space; the illuminated child and adult's profile emerge from it. No outdoor scenery, no photographic cloth or bread texture, no facial details, no 3D CGI. Spare dreamlike handmade animation design, purposeful edges and mysterious tonal depth, no text.

studies.name: Paint on glass
studies.style: Medium and mark rules: PAINT-ON-GLASS ANIMATION still, luminous opaque and translucent oil/watercolor ink marks pushed, scraped, lifted and repainted on a smooth plate. Thick broad fluid paint silhouettes, visible dragged brush edges, occasional finger-width lifted trails and translucent overlap. A few prior contours remain as intentional faint paint ghosts immediately beside clothing edges, not duplicated bodies or extra limbs. Cool cobalt and blue-black, chalk white, restrained vermilion; preserve clean light areas and avoid sepia. Child/adult faces are compact anonymous organic profiles sculpted from 2 to 3 creamy paint strokes; heads and hands legible, intact, not melting. Adult's white shirt and dark apron, child's blue coat, counter and window each read as broad painterly masses. Loaf a single pale oval with three dragged navy slashes. THREE jars suggested in three individual paint gestures. Every region has a chosen edge: scraped hard counter edge, fluid coat contour, soft translucent background. Frame feels caught in a continuous handcrafted transformation while this specific encounter remains completely clear. No realistic photographed glass, no 3D reflections, no oil-gallery impasto excess, no generic watercolor paper grain. Marks have material cause and rhythmic restraint. Mature expressive film animation rather than decorative illustration.
